architect.description: Shapes architecture direction, reversibility, boundaries, and fitness functions.

coder.description: Owns technical discovery, developer tests, implementation, diagnosis, and code evolution.

planner.description: Frames observable goals, assigns specialist ownership, and closes the run.

supervisor.description: Performs only deterministic checks named by a handoff.

tester.description: Owns product contracts, business cases, executable business tests, and assertion intent.

title-compressor.description: Compresses one handoff into a single registry title line.

verify.description: Creates independent execution evidence and classifies what it proves.

zipper.description: Semantically compresses oversized Bash output while preserving actionable evidence.
